backtestFeedback.title: Test saved signals and opinions
backtestFeedback.intro: Read-only event study using stored prices. No new AI analysis, orders or paid data calls.
backtestFeedback.method: Entry: first stored daily close strictly after the UTC availability date (signal creation or final opinion completion). Exit: 1, 5, 20 or 60 stored sessions after entry. Current UTC-day bars are excluded. Fees apply to entry and exit traded notionals. Results are independent observations, not compounded portfolio returns.
backtestFeedback.limitations: Historical prices may be revised or omit splits/dividends, delisted instruments and sessions. Selection and survivorship bias remain. Overlapping records are not independent trades. Currency, cash, liquidity, slippage, borrow costs, tax and portfolio constraints are not simulated. Signal status is its current saved status, not its historical status. Neutral or unknown ratings are skipped.
backtestFeedback.signalFilters: Strength and status filters apply only to signals. Opinions use Buy/Overweight → long, Sell/Underweight → short; Hold and other ratings are skipped.
backtestFeedback.truncated: The record limit was reached. Narrow the date range or increase the limit to include more records.
backtestFeedback.parameterScope: Results use the submitted settings. Submit again after changing the form.
